SELECT * FROM financial_product WHERE is_active = 1
AND ( product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR eligibility LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY category_similarity DESC,id DESC

SELECT fp.*
FROM financial_product fp
INNER JOIN property p ON p.id = #{propertyId}
WHERE fp.is_active = 1
AND fp.trade_type = p.trade_type
ORDER BY fp.category_similarity DESC, fp.min_rate ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT id, trade_type, product_type, description, embedding
FROM financial_product_category
WHERE embedding IS NULL
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, trade_type, product_type, description, embedding
FROM financial_product_category
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, product_name, eligibility, embedding
FROM financial_product
WHERE embedding IS NULL
ORDER BY id

SELECT id, product_name, eligibility, embedding, trade_type, product_type, category_similarity
FROM financial_product
WHERE embedding IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY id
